title: KooKoos Skyblock
description: A modpack for hypixel skyblock that tries make it feel more polished.
body:
![Hypixel Skyblock Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f80dbc892cb08ab50a988a98744f15a5f57c11c.png)
[Logo By: WynnicWither](https://hypixel.net/members/wynnicwither.6331995/)

A cutom made modpack for Hypixel Skyblock for the newest version that improves on the playability for new players and veterans.

![Hub](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88b636c7dd1c96856de7078e302031b2fd9c9d2e.jpeg)

It focuses highly on the visuals, customizabilty and QOL with custom picked mods such as;

## **Skyblock Mods:**
- [Skyblocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap)
- [Firmament](https://modrinth.com/mod/firmament)
- [NoFrills](https://modrinth.com/mod/nofrills)
- [Aarons's Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/aaron-mod)
- [Modern Warp Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modern-warp-menu)

## **Visual Mods:**
- [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)
- [Better Clouds](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds)
- [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers)
- [3D Armor](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-3d)
- [Visuality](https://modrinth.com/mod/visuality)
- [Particular](https://modrinth.com/mod/particular-reforged)
- [Subtle Effects](https://modrinth.com/mod/subtle-effects)
- [Falling Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/fallingleaves)
- [Particle Interactions](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-interactions)
- [Particle Rain](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-rain)
- [Mas Effects](https://modrinth.com/mod/mas-effects)
- [Make Bubbles Pop](https://modrinth.com/mod/make_bubbles_pop)
- [Fancy World Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/fwa)
- [Better Biome Blend](https://modrinth.com/mod/bbrb)
- [Ambient Environment](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambient-environment)
- [Armor Hider](https://modrinth.com/mod/zannaghs-armor-hider)
